description: ETCS and Railway Network Raw Dataset is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors David KULE MUKUHI, Fawzi KHOURI. "The ETCS (European Train Control System) and Railway Network Raw Dataset is a raw railway communication and operation dataset collected from the private network of the French National Railways operator (SNCF) and intended to support research on intelligent railway networking, ETCS-aware communications, mobility management, and data-driven railway system optimization. Coverage: national (FR); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
